title: Gathered sources (`corpus/`)
intro: Source material as collected: public government records, statute texts, agency pages and forum pulls.

archives.corpus/ab2533.tar.gz: AB 2533 pilot: Gov. Code 66311.7 and HSC 17920.3 verbatim from leginfo, source links, city checklists, process pages.
archives.corpus/counties.tar.gz: County-scale sources for all 58 California counties: covariates (USDA ERS, Census Gazetteer, ACS, Statement of Vote) with a column-by-column source README; HCD Annual Progress Report Tables A and A2 (housing permit timing, 383 MB); CalFresh CF296, CF18 and CF256 county reports and State Auditor reports; civil grand jury reports (exhaustive pull, 2026-09-17); permit-portal observations; San Diego building events; Reddit pulls per county (`reddit_raw/`); coverage registers.
archives.corpus/health_codes.tar.gz: Restaurant inspection and grading codes (San Diego operations guide 2007, New York items) and a gold crosswalk.
archives.corpus/realworld.tar.gz: Process reconnaissance for nine California programs: ADU permit, CalFresh, CPRA request, CSLB license, DROS firearm purchase, food facility permit, N-400 naturalization, rooftop solar permit, UI claim. Agency pages, forms, fee schedules and forum threads per program. `_gold/` and each `sources.json` are benchmark answer material.
archives.corpus/tax.tar.gz: SARA statutory-reasoning dataset (third party): US tax statutes, Prolog encodings and cases.

title: Synthetic worlds (`benchmark/synth/worlds/`)
intro: Generated worlds: a latent statute, its processes and cases, and the rendered evidence (forum posts, agency pages, records). Each world keeps its truth (answer key) beside the evidence.

archives.benchmark/synth/worlds/W1.tar.gz: First synthetic world: specs, rendered artifacts, render batches and logs, provenance.
archives.benchmark/synth/worlds/W2_DEV_001.tar.gz: W2 development world: statutes S01 to S12 across jurisdictions, full rendered evidence corpus, ceilings and truth (34k files). Release report: `docs/2026-09-16-w2-dev-001-release-report.md`.
archives.benchmark/synth/worlds/THREE_FAMILY_PILO: Three-family pilot world 1: `public/` evidence, `private/` truth, construction receipt.
Three-family pilot world 3 (same layout); used for render calibration.
archives.benchmark/synth/worlds/_fixture.tar.gz: Small test fixture world (also in git).
